name: nn_open
description: Show the Neural Net Lab on the ML desk: a small neural network learning a 2D dataset live, TensorFlow Playground style (decision boundary, every neuron's picture, accuracy). Use it for 'show me the neural network', 'open the playground'.

name: nn_close
description: Switch the ML desk from the Neural Net Lab back to the ML project's panels (training dashboard, dataset, model, results). Use it for 'back to my ML project', 'show the training dashboard', 'close the neural net'.

name: nn_status
description: The Neural Net Lab right now: dataset, layers, activation, learning rate, epoch, train and test accuracy and loss; each neuron's id (L1N3 = layer 1, neuron 3 from the top), whether it's on, what it detects, and test_accuracy_if_toggled (how much it matters); and the last changes with accuracy before and after. Use it to answer 'why did the accuracy drop?' or 'what does this neuron do?': name the neuron, what it detected, and the before/after numbers.

name: nn_control
description: Change the Neural Net Lab: play / pause / step one epoch / reset the weights / restore_all (switch every neuron back on), the dataset, the activation, the learning rate, the hidden layers (e.g. [4, 2] = two layers of 4 and 2 neurons, at most 6 layers of 8) and the input features. Changing the data, layers, activation or features starts training over.

features.description: inputs: x, y, x2 (x²), y2, xy (x·y), sinx, siny

name: nn_neuron
description: Switch one hidden neuron of the Neural Net Lab off (enabled false) or back on. The accuracy changes at once; the result has it before and after. 'Turn off neuron 3 in layer 1' is L1N3.

name: nn_improve
description: The user asks how to make the Neural Net Lab's network better ('why is it bad?', 'fix it', 'what can I do better?'). Returns what's wrong (the diagnosis) and the changes that fix it; say them briefly and ask whether to apply. An Apply card also pops up. Nothing changes until nn_apply.

name: nn_apply
description: Only after the user says yes to the nn_improve proposal: apply it and train live. The new test accuracy shows in Albie's bubble when it settles (about 10 seconds).
